requirement.original: Per-session model persistence: each session must remember the model the user last selected for that session; navigating away and returning must NOT revert to the default. Model indicator in status bar: the currently selected model must be displayed on the RIGHT SIDE of the status bar, immediately to the LEFT of the yolo (permission-mode) indicator. Manual-only changes: the only event that changes a session's active model is the user manually switching in the GUI — no implicit/automatic changes on re-entry/reload/reconnect/restart. This is spec §5.1.
requirement.clarified: Mirror the permission-mode MMKV persistence plumbing for model-mode (add loadSessionModelModes/saveSessionModelModes in persistence.ts, wire into store init and applySession in storage.ts, add MMKV write to updateSessionModelMode), and add a model-name chip to the status-bar footer immediately before the permission badge in AgentInput.tsx.
requirement.what: Add MMKV persistence for per-session model selection and display active model in status-bar footer
requirement.why: Model selection is lost on session re-entry because updateSessionModelMode only writes to Zustand, with no MMKV write or reload path, unlike the already-working permission-mode plumbing

included: Add loadSessionModelModes() and saveSessionModelModes() in persistence.ts
Initialize sessionModelModes in storage.ts store init block
Apply saved modelMode in applySession forEach loop with 4-priority resolution chain
Add MMKV write to updateSessionModelMode after Zustand state update
Add model chip View in AgentInput.tsx footer, immediately before permission badge View
Extend footer row visibility condition to show row when non-default model is active
excluded: Changing the model automatically on reconnect/reload/restart
Changes to the model picker overlay itself
Changes to model option definitions or getDefaultModelKey

success_criteria: After user selects a non-default model in session A and navigates away and back, session.modelMode still reflects the selected model
Status-bar footer displays a model chip immediately left of the permission badge when a non-default model is active
Model chip is absent (and footer row hidden) when both model and permission mode are default
Only onModelModeChange (user GUI action) triggers a change to the stored model key
yarn typecheck passes with no new errors
constraints: Use MMKV (mmkv.set / mmkv.getString) — not AsyncStorage or any other store
MMKV key must be 'session-model-modes' (plural, matching 'session-permission-modes' pattern)
Do NOT save entries with key 'default' to MMKV (same skip logic as permission-mode)
Model chip icon must use an Ionicons icon already available in the project, size 11
All user-visible strings must use t() — model name comes from props.modelMode.name (already i18n-safe)

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Selecting a non-default model in a session, navigating away, and returning reverts the model to the default. No model name is shown in the status bar.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: updateSessionModelMode (storage.ts:864-882) writes to Zustand in-memory state only. There is no saveSessionModelModes() call, no loadSessionModelModes() at store init, and no MMKV-sourced override in the applySession resolution path — unlike updateSessionPermissionMode which has all three.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — oversight when permission-mode persistence was added; model-mode updater was not given the same treatment
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Permission-mode persistence was added as a feature; model-mode updater was presumably added earlier or in a different pass without applying the same persistence pattern
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: On re-entry, applySession resolves modelMode from (session.modelMode=null after re-hydration) OR (session.metadata.currentModelCode, server value) OR getDefaultModelKey(flavor), silently reverting to default every time
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Persistent throughout — no regression; model-mode was never persisted
